title: The Blue Dress
subtitle: The question I wasn't supposed to ask
label: From the essay
quote: That’s not my name. It’s incomplete, suffocated by her breath, as if saying my full name might give me agency to be a full person and not her emotional walking stick.
alt_text: Cream card with an italic quote: That’s not my name. It’s incomplete, suffocated by her breath, as if saying my full name might give me agency to be a full person and not her emotional walking stick. From The Blue Dress. Not Plain.

captions.instagram:
“That’s not my name. It’s incomplete, suffocated by her breath, as if saying my full name might give me agency to be a full person and not her emotional walking stick.”

My mom called me Sar. I hated when she called me that. She says it in a JCPenney dressing room too, on the day my brain won’t let me drop a question.

From The Blue Dress, on Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.
